entry.content:
TP-Link ER605 DDNS Pre-Auth RCE: Chaining CVE-2024-5242, CVE-2024-5243, CVE-2024-5244

2026-02-04Barrack

Technical analysis and exploit reproduction of CVE-2024-5242/5243/5244 chain targeting TP-Link ER605 router’s cmxddnsd daemon, originally discovered at Pwn2Own Toronto 2023. Details BSS overflow for ASLR bypass and stack overflow for ROP-based RCE.

entry.title: Four Bytes, One Lie: A SMAP-Free Confidence Trick on Kernel Pointers
entry.content:
Four Bytes, One Lie: A SMAP-Free Confidence Trick on Kernel Pointers

2025-11-03Hyeonjin

A deep-dive technical analysis of CVE-2025-50168, a Windows kernel vulnerability (Type Confusion in DirectComposition) presented at Pwn2Own Berlin 2025. This post details how a 4-byte OOB write is escalated into an AAR/AAW primitive using IoRing to achieve Local Privilege Escalation (LPE).

entry.title: About
entry.content:
About

2024-01-01David

Out of Bounds is a cybersecurity company driven by curiosity and a passion for pushing boundaries. We specialize in vulnerability research, diving deep into systems to uncover the flaws that others miss.

We believe offensive security has the power to make the digital world safer. Our team combines elite technical expertise with a creative mindset—transforming complex problems into real-world breakthroughs.

Our journey began on the global stage with back-to-back wins at Pwn2Own Vancouver 2024 and Berlin 2025. But for us, that’s just the beginning. We’re here to keep raising the bar and redefining the possibilities of security research.

Beyond research, we are committed to empowering the next generation. We actively mentor exceptional young talent, providing them with the tools, guidance, and the global stage they need to thrive.

We’re still early in our journey, and we can’t wait for what’s next.

Happy Hacking!
